notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are true facts about real diseases, stated in the prompt. Slot 0025 held a reflexivity edit ('is a symptom of' is reflexive) until 2026-10-22, when reflexivity was dropped as an RBox property: its only instances ask whether a thing is related to itself.
